basis.title: Design standards: employer's requirements – Technical Manual (ER-DFE-XX-XX-T-X-0201, revision A-C01)
basis.label: Air handling units (AHUs), room-based ventilation units, extract fans and controls: 20 years
basis.note: Printed page 256. AHUs, room-based (heat recovery) ventilation units and extract fans; supply/return fans in AHUs included. Minimum life expectancy (design requirement) for DfE-funded school buildings. Minimum design requirements placed on contractors for school buildings, not observed replacement ages. Section 5.1.4 (sanitaryware) refers to CIBSE Guide M Appendix 12.A1 'in general'.

basis.title: Energy Conservation Program: Energy Conservation Standards for Fans and Blowers (notice of proposed rulemaking), 89 FR 3714, January 19, 2024
basis.by: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Energy Efficiency and Renewable Energy
basis.label: Equipment Lifetime: GFBs, "15 years in the commercial sector based on the expected lifetimes of HVAC equipment"
basis.note: Printed page 3788. Commercial-sector lifetime for general fans and blowers (all fan types). Proposed rule; the 15 years is borrowed from HVAC equipment lifetimes, not fan data.

basis.title: General depreciation rates (IR265), July 2021
basis.by: Inland Revenue (Te Tari Taake), New Zealand
basis.label: Ventilating fans
basis.note: Printed page 44. Ventilating fans, not ducted or roof-mounted (e.g. wall or window fans). BDFO Building fit-out (when in books separately from building cost). Printed DV 20%, SL 13.5%. Tax depreciation lives set by the Commissioner of Inland Revenue for New Zealand income tax, not engineering or asset-management lives; they are banded and often short (e.g. reticulation piping 25 years). The July 2021 edition was the newest PDF reachable; the online Depreciation Rate Finder may hold later determinations.

basis.title: Future Buildings Standard: final stage impact assessment (RPC-MHCLG-25104-IA), 24 March 2026
basis.by: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government (UK)
basis.label: "20 years for light fittings and ventilation equipment"
basis.note: Printed page 77. One value for two groups. Light fittings in new buildings are LED (the IA applies LED cost learning). 'Ventilation equipment' is generic; mapped to the ventilation component types it clearly includes. Assumption for new non-domestic buildings in England; the IA says the lifetimes are in line with BS EN 15459 (Annex/Appendix E), but they are stated as the department's own modelling assumptions, not a reproduced table. Round-number economic-appraisal assumptions, not observed lives. Same values as the January 2021 Future Buildings Standard consultation IA (separate file), so the two are not independent.

open_questions: Every source here is a published planning, design or accounting life. None is observed replacement data.
